necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness to guide further management. This service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42.
